notes.title: Episode 2 for FREE!
notes.notes:
This game became free, referring to the opinion from the player. Please enjoy the story until Episode 3!

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice of giving a reward for customers
notes.notes:
This game is scheduled to be free on Friday, March 15, 2019 by STEAM.
Perhaps we will switch the game itself to the free version on March 14th of Japan time(JST). 
Please download the bonus displayed on the title screen of the game.
In the free version, the decompress password of the FPS game file which is the reward for customers will not be displayed.

Thank you!

notes.title: Important notice
notes.notes:
We are working to make this game free.
Because we want more players to play episode 3.
People who bought this game can download the FPS game "Zero spring episode 1 Director's Cut" from Sonic-Alpha's site.
In this game, all the documents are translated into English.
The URL and the password to decompress the downloaded file are written on the title screen of "episode 2" NOW.
You can not receive this benefit in this game after becoming free.
Only the person who bought this game can receive it.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: The story is complete!
notes.notes:
Zero spring episode 3 was released and the story was completed.
Please purchase bundle sets that you can complete "All Zero spring episodes"
